purpose: Present a conversational message with its metadata.
avoid: Do not remove speaker identity when visually compacting messages.
basis: Pinned React/primitive sources lead API, lifecycle and semantics; native visual observations and explicit reference decisions are mapped in figma/traceability.json.
profileRationale: Meaningful native content or a content container in its default source mode. Interactive descendants/native render overrides keep their own native or component contracts; no decorative fallback or invented selection API.
contentAlternative: Speaker, time and message body are text. Alignment or avatar alone must not identify the speaker.
updatesAndDescendants: MessageGroup/Message and slots are native div wrappers; align=end reverses visual direction. They do not store messages, send replies, announce streams or manage scrolling. MessageScroller or a caller-owned log region controls those behaviors.
referenceDecision: Speaker/time markup and reply Button are caller-supplied reference children. A live log is a separate context decision, not an unconditional role added to every message.

visualContract.layoutPolicy: Message maps all six actual wrappers. Visual frame names are not promoted to code identities: the native horizontal Message content example supplies the 8px avatar/row gap, while the actual MessageContent code wrapper is vertical and takes the observed 10px vertical gap. Representative group gap 24px,32px round avatar,12px metadata inset and 12/16px footer text are retained. Native header frame 16px conflicts with its actual 14/20px text; this reference retains 20px text height without clipping. Footer has 24px minimum and grows for native actions. Speaker/time and delivery text are explicit caller content, not inferred states or automatic announcements. Align=end reverses the row using actual data-align; logical layout works with direction. MessageGroup has no automatic live-log or pagination behavior. Optional Bubble children and new-message announcements remain explicit caller composition.
